name: supper-app
description: Super app React Native: giao diện điều khiển từ xa (hướng A) + mini-app remote bundle thật (hướng B)

scripts.test: node tools/sdui-bind.test.mjs && node tools/shared-deps.test.mjs && node tools/mini-registry.test.mjs && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON tools/mini-bridge.test.mjs && node tools/mini-signing.test.mjs && npm --prefix dashboard test
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix dashboard install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc -p mobile --noEmit && npx tsc -p mini-apps/insurance --noEmit && npx tsc -p mini-apps/invest --noEmit && npx tsc -p packages/mini-sdk --noEmit
